summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, which writes the control only when is_terminal and returns False otherwise. rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. New tests: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only module). Tests were not run, per instructions, and Black was not run; new lines were checked to be under 88 characters. Nothing was committed.
